verses.text: By Solomon. God, give the king your sense of justice and give your righteousness to the king’s son.
He’ll judge your people with righteousness and give the poor the justice they deserve.
May the mountains bring the people prosperity and the hills yield the fruit of righteousness.
May he defend the poor, save the children of those in need, and crush the oppressor.
May people fear you as long as the sun and moon endure, through every generation.
May the king come down like rain on freshly cut grass, like showers watering the earth.
In his days may the righteous flourish and peace abound until the moon is gone.
May he rule from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
May those who live in the wilderness bow before him and his enemies lick the dust.
May the kings of Tarshish and the islands bring tribute, and the kings of Sheba and Seba bring gifts.
May every king bow before him and every nation serve him.
He’ll rescue the needy when they cry out, and the poor who have no one to help.
He’ll have compassion on the poor and needy, and he’ll save the lives of those in need.
He’ll rescue them from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious to him.
May he live long and receive gold from Sheba. May people pray for him continually and bless him all day long.
May grain grow in abundance throughout the land. May its fruit sway like Lebanon and flourish like grass in the fields.
May his name last forever, as long as the sun shines. May people find blessing through him and all nations call him blessed.
Praise the LORD God, the God of Israel. He alone does wonderful things.
Bless his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
This ends the prayers of David son of Jesse.
